findings: The card requires today's close to be the neckline-break confirmation, but source line 194 only tests close>neckline and never requires the prior close to be at/below the neckline; stale post-breakout bars can therefore generate entries.

The stale-breakout guard is a function-static p2 timestamp (lines 103/172/232): it resets on EA restart and is set before QM_TM_OpenPosition reports success, enabling restart re-entry while suppressing a legitimate retry after broker rejection.

The approved target exit is evaluated from a completed bar and closed at the next bar's open, but source line 227 installs req.tp as an intrabar broker target, changing exit timing and realized price.
The card requires a 20-trading-bar time stop, but source line 258 compares wall-clock seconds (TimeCurrent-opened >= 20*PeriodSeconds(D1)); weekends make it close before 20 completed D1 bars.

Source artifact is not the canonical build_result.json schema: required fields ea_dir, magic_base, symbols_registered, compile_succeeded, smoke_result, and smoke_report_path are absent; no smoke report is bound.
All 13 generated setfiles contain card_defaults_status=none_found and zero strategy_* values, so they were not regenerated against the twelve built strategy inputs.
SPEC.md contains a malformed slug (\bandy-double-bottom-formalised-mr-index) and a corrupted backtest risk value (,000), despite passing the section-header validator.
